_source: Verbatim extraction of helm repo docs/TRUST.md §1 (Network-behavior doc, runtime-calls table rows 1-12), read 2026-09-08 from the local helm checkout. TODO-KIT: the scheduled vendor step copies this again when HELM-AGENT-KIT-1 lands.
section: TRUST.md §1 runtime calls (helmd / browser UI, normal use)

endpoints.trigger: On by default. Fired by helmd itself, in the background, right after each checkpoint it takes. Never blocks daemon startup; a relay failure yields a queued/skipped marker instead of a real anchor.
endpoints.payload: Raw TSQ DER built from the checkpoint's SHA-256 hash only. No document content.
endpoints.disable: set "anchorOnCheckpoint": false in ~/.helm/config.json; the daemon then skips the relay call and every checkpoint is saved with a skipped/egress_blocked marker

endpoints.trigger: OpenTimestamps anchoring. Present in code, not called by anything at runtime.

endpoints.endpoint: Connector-defined host (via performEgress, DNS-rebind checked, redirect: manual)
endpoints.payload: Whatever that connector's send() builds; scoped to its own allowlisted host.
endpoints.disable: do not install or sign the connector contract

endpoints.trigger: Google Drive fetch connector. fileId is curated, compile-time-only config, never a live workflow.run caller value.
endpoints.payload: OAuth bearer token out; file bytes back, kept in-process.

endpoints.trigger: User clicks Connect in the UI.
endpoints.payload: Authorization code + PKCE verifier + client_id + redirect_uri. No client secret.
Standard OAuth authorize redirect. Not a server-side call.

endpoints.trigger: Browser-only mode (no helmd installed); user connects a provider.
endpoints.payload: PKCE code exchange; response tokens land in sessionStorage/vault.
endpoints.disable: install helmd; stay in daemon mode

endpoints.endpoint: GET https://api.github.com/user with Authorization: Bearer <pasted PAT>
endpoints.trigger: User pastes a fine-grained PAT to verify it.
endpoints.payload: The pasted PAT, to GitHub only, to confirm it is valid.

endpoints.trigger: On by default. Fired by helmd on behalf of row 12, once on every UI boot and then hourly; also once whenever helmd doctor runs.
endpoints.payload: Bare GET, no request body, no identifiers, no user or workflow data. Response is a static version-notice JSON used only to show a passive update banner; never downloaded or applied automatically. Like any HTTP request it necessarily reveals the caller's IP and User-Agent to the server.
endpoints.disable: set "versionCheckUrl": "" (or omit and let a falsy value pass) in ~/.helm/config.json; the /version-check handler then returns { checked: false, reason: "disabled" } without making row 10's outbound call at all

endpoints.trigger: Browser UI probing a local helmd for handoff, only on explicit user click, never on page load.
endpoints.payload: Loopback only. Never leaves the machine.

endpoints.trigger: Browser UI, authenticated loopback call that triggers row 10: once on boot, then hourly.
endpoints.payload: Loopback only. Never leaves the machine; the outbound leg it triggers is row 10.
